verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with AI features (Sona, call transcription and summaries, AI call tags, MCP and LLM connectors), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any control that keeps customer data out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
